title: Differential Duels — Shoulder or Neck? Hip or Spine?

hook.en: The shoulder hurts, but the problem is in the neck. The groin hurts, but the problem is in the back. Experts win these duels with a few smart questions and tests, not with longer examinations. Learn the clues that tip the balance.
hook.ur: Kandha dukhta hai, lekin masla gardan mein hota hai. Groin dukhti hai, lekin masla kamar mein hota hai. Maahir yeh muqabilay lambay exam se nahi, chand samajhdar sawalon aur tests se jeette hain. Woh clues seekhein jo palra jhukate hain.

goal.en: By the end, you'll run a short duel for shoulder versus neck and hip versus spine, use a cluster of findings instead of one test, and know when the answer is "both" or "neither".
goal.ur: End tak aap kandha versus gardan aur hip versus reedh ke liye chhota muqabla chalayenge, ek test ke bajaye findings ka cluster istemal karenge, aur jaanenge ke jawab kab "dono" ya "koi nahi" hota hai.

text.en: Pain is a poor map. The brain places pain where it **feels** it, and nerves from the neck, shoulder and arm share pathways, so a problem in one place can be felt in another. This is why one test is never enough. A good duel asks three things: **where does the pain come from, what movement changes it, and what happens when I load or unload each suspect?**
text.ur: Dard ka naqsha kamzor hota hai. Dimagh dard wahan rakhta hai jahan woh **mehsoos** karta hai, aur gardan, kandhay aur bazu ke nerves ke raaste milte hain, isliye ek jagah ka masla doosri jagah mehsoos ho sakta hai. Isi liye ek test kabhi kaafi nahi. Achha muqabla teen sawal poochta hai: **dard kahan se aata hai, kaun si harkat isko badalti hai, aur har shak wale hissay ko load ya unload karne par kya hota hai?**

text.en: Think of **two neighbours with a noisy pipe**. The noise comes through the wall, so you cannot tell which flat it starts in. You try closing one tap at a time: when the noise stops, you have found the source. Your tests do the same: reduce the load on the neck, and if the shoulder pain eases, the neck is involved; load the shoulder, and if the pain is exactly reproduced, it is involved too.
text.ur: **Do padosiyon ki shor karti pipe** sochein. Shor deewar ke paar se aata hai, isliye aap nahi bata sakte ke kis flat se shuru hota hai. Aap ek ek nal band karke dekhte hain: jab shor ruk jaye to source mil gaya. Aap ke tests bhi yahi karte hain: gardan ka load kam karein, agar kandhay ka dard kam ho to gardan shamil hai; kandhay ko load karein, agar dard bilkul wahi dohra jaye to woh bhi shamil hai.

title.en: Shoulder or neck? Clues that tip the balance
title.ur: Kandha ya gardan? Palra jhukane wale clues

rows.en: Where is the pain?
rows.ur: Dard kahan hai?

rows.en: Spreads below the elbow, with tingling or numbness in fingers
rows.ur: Kohni ke neeche phailta hai, ungliyon mein jhunjhuni ya sunn

rows.en: Over the outer upper arm and around the joint, rarely below the elbow
rows.ur: Bazu ke bahar aur joint ke gird, kohni ke neeche kam

rows.en: What changes it?
rows.ur: Isko kya badalta hai?

rows.en: Neck movement, looking down, or a hand on top of the head (shoulder abduction relief) eases it
rows.ur: Gardan ki harkat, neeche dekhna, ya sar par haath rakhna (shoulder abduction relief) aram deta hai

rows.en: Lifting the arm, reaching behind, lying on the side
rows.ur: Bazu uthana, peeche pahunchna, karwat par letna

rows.en: What do the tests show?
rows.ur: Tests kya dikhate hain?

rows.en: Spurling test and distraction test positive, neck rotation limited
rows.ur: Spurling test aur distraction test positive, gardan ki rotation kam

rows.en: Painful arc, rotator cuff tests positive, local tenderness
rows.ur: Painful arc, rotator cuff tests positive, jagah par nazuki

rows.en: Neurology
rows.ur: Neurology

rows.en: Reflex, sensation or muscle change in a root pattern
rows.ur: Root ke pattern mein reflex, ehsaas ya muscle ki tabdeeli

rows.en: Normal reflexes and sensation; weakness is from pain or tendon damage
rows.ur: Reflexes aur ehsaas normal; kamzori dard ya tendon ke nuksan se

question.en: A 48-year-old has right shoulder-blade and outer arm pain with tingling in the thumb and index finger. Looking down makes it worse and placing the hand on top of the head eases it. Which duel result is most likely?
question.ur: 48 saal ke mareez ko dayen shoulder-blade aur bazu ke bahar ka dard hai aur angoothay aur shahadat ki ungli mein jhunjhuni. Neeche dekhne se zyada aur sar par haath rakhne se kam. Kaun sa nateeja zyada imkaan hai?

feedback.en: That limits passive shoulder movement in all directions and does not cause finger tingling.
feedback.ur: Yeh kandhay ki passive harkat har rukh mein mehdood karta hai aur ungliyon mein jhunjhuni nahi deta.

text.en: A rotator cuff tendon problem alone
text.ur: Sirf rotator cuff tendon ka masla

feedback.en: A cuff problem rarely causes finger tingling or changes with neck posture.
feedback.ur: Cuff ka masla kam hi ungliyon mein jhunjhuni deta hai ya gardan ki posture se badalta hai.

text.en: Cervical radiculopathy (neck) is the leading suspect

feedback.en: Yes — arm symptoms below the elbow, neck movement and the hand-on-head relief all point to a neck root.
feedback.ur: Haan — kohni ke neeche ke symptoms, gardan ki harkat aur sar par haath rakhne se aram, sab gardan ki root ki taraf ishara karte hain.

text.en: A well-known cluster of four findings supports a cervical root cause: **a positive Spurling test, a positive distraction test, neck rotation less than 60 degrees to the affected side, and a positive upper limb tension test**. The more present, the more likely. In the original study, three positive findings raised the probability a great deal and all four made the diagnosis very likely, but a rule does not replace the story: always check reflexes, sensation and strength and ask about red flags.
text.ur: Chaar findings ka mashhoor cluster gardan ki root ki wajah ko support karta hai: **positive Spurling test, positive distraction test, mutasir taraf gardan ki rotation 60 degree se kam, aur positive upper limb tension test**. Jitne zyada maujood, utna zyada imkaan. Asal study mein teen positive findings ne imkaan bohat barhaya aur chaaron ne diagnosis bohat mumkin bana di, lekin rule kahani ki jagah nahi leta: hamesha reflex, ehsaas aur taqat check karein aur red flags poochhein.

title.en: Hip or spine? Clues that tip the balance
title.ur: Hip ya reedh? Palra jhukane wale clues

rows.en: Where is the pain?
rows.ur: Dard kahan hai?

rows.en: Groin, front of the thigh, sometimes the knee
rows.ur: Groin, thigh ka saamne wala hissa, kabhi kabhi ghutna

rows.en: Low back, buttock, down the back or side of the leg
rows.ur: Neeche ki kamar, kulhay, taang ke peeche ya side mein

rows.en: What changes it?
rows.ur: Isko kya badalta hai?

rows.en: Walking, getting in and out of a car, putting on socks, sitting for long
rows.ur: Chalna, gaari mein baithna uthna, moze pehenna, der tak baithna

rows.en: Bending forward, standing up from sitting, coughing, certain back positions
rows.ur: Aage jhukna, baithne se uthna, khansi, kamar ki kuch positions

rows.en: What do the tests show?
rows.ur: Tests kya dikhate hain?

rows.en: Hip internal rotation limited and painful, groin pain on FADIR or scour test
rows.ur: Hip ki internal rotation mehdood aur dardnaak, FADIR ya scour test par groin ka dard

rows.en: Straight leg raise or slump reproduces leg pain, back extension or flexion reproduces it
rows.ur: SLR ya slump taang ka dard dohrate hain, kamar ki extension ya flexion dohrati hai

rows.en: Neurology
rows.ur: Neurology

rows.en: Normal reflexes and sensation
rows.ur: Reflexes aur ehsaas normal

rows.en: Root pattern changes may be present
rows.ur: Root pattern ki tabdeeli ho sakti hai

question.en: A 62-year-old has groin pain when walking and difficulty putting on socks. Hip internal rotation is limited and painful. Back movements are normal and the straight leg raise is negative. Which is most likely?
question.ur: 62 saal ke mareez ko chalte waqt groin ka dard aur moze pehenne mein mushkil hai. Hip ki internal rotation mehdood aur dardnaak hai. Kamar ki harkatein normal aur straight leg raise negative hai. Kaun sa zyada imkaan hai?

text.en: A lumbar disc causing nerve pain
text.ur: Lumbar disc jo nerve ka dard de raha ho

feedback.en: The spine screen and nerve tests are negative.
feedback.ur: Reedh ki screen aur nerve tests negative hain.

feedback.en: That causes pain at the back of the thigh, not the groin.
feedback.ur: Yeh thigh ke peeche dard deta hai, groin mein nahi.

feedback.en: Yes — groin pain, loss of hip internal rotation and a normal spine screen fit the hip.
feedback.ur: Haan — groin ka dard, hip ki internal rotation ka kam hona aur normal reedh screen hip se milte hain.

title.en: A three-step duel you can use on any patient
title.ur: Teen qadam ka muqabla jo aap har mareez par istemal kar sakte hain

steps.title: Listen for the story
steps.detail: Where, spreading where, what makes it better or worse, what is the first thing that changed? || Kahani suniye

steps.title: Test both suspects
steps.detail: Move, load and test each region. Reproduce the exact pain; if testing one area does not reproduce it, move to the next. || Dono shak walon ko test karein

steps.title: Change one thing and re-test
steps.detail: Unload or load one suspect and see whether the main finding changes. This is how you confirm and how you decide what to treat first. || Ek cheez badal kar dobara test

text.en: **Testing only where it hurts.** If you examine the painful shoulder and stop, you will diagnose the shoulder every time. Always screen the joint above and below, and test the neck whenever there is arm pain and the spine whenever there is hip or thigh pain.
text.ur: **Sirf wahan test karna jahan dukhta hai.** Agar aap sirf dukhta kandha dekh kar ruk jayein to har baar kandha hi diagnose karenge. Hamesha upar aur neeche ka joint screen karein, bazu ke dard mein gardan aur hip ya thigh ke dard mein reedh test karein.

question.en: Which set of findings favours the SHOULDER rather than the neck as the main source?
question.ur: Kaun si findings gardan ke bajaye KANDHAY ko asal source banati hain?

text.en: A painful arc and a positive rotator cuff test, with normal neck movement, reflexes and sensation
text.ur: Painful arc aur positive rotator cuff test, jabke gardan ki harkat, reflexes aur ehsaas normal hon

feedback.en: Yes — local signs reproduce the pain while the neck screen is clear.
feedback.ur: Haan — local signs dard dohrate hain jabke gardan ki screen saaf hai.

text.en: Relief from placing the hand on top of the head
text.ur: Sar par haath rakhne se aram

feedback.en: That is a neck sign (shoulder abduction relief).
feedback.ur: Yeh gardan ka sign hai (shoulder abduction relief).

text.en: Tingling in the fingers and a reduced triceps reflex
text.ur: Ungliyon mein jhunjhuni aur triceps reflex kam

feedback.en: Those are root signs and point to the neck.
feedback.ur: Yeh root ke signs hain aur gardan ki taraf ishara karte hain.

text.en: **Explain "both".** Many patients have a neck problem and a shoulder problem. Say: "Your neck and your shoulder are both contributing. We will treat the part that changes your pain most first, then re-check the other." This builds trust and avoids blaming the patient for a pain that "moves".
text.ur: **"Dono" samjhayein.** Bohat se mareezon ko gardan aur kandha dono ka masla hota hai. Kahein: "Aap ki gardan aur kandha dono hissa daal rahe hain. Jis hissay se dard sab se zyada badalta hai pehle usi ka ilaaj karenge, phir doosre ko dobara check karenge." Isse bharosa banta hai aur "ghoomte" dard ka ilzam mareez par nahi aata.

question.en: Why do examiners ask for a cluster of findings rather than one special test?
question.ur: Examiners ek khaas test ke bajaye findings ka cluster kyun maangte hain?

answer.en: Because most single tests have limited accuracy. A cluster changes the odds: each extra positive finding raises the chance that the suspect is right, and a negative cluster lowers it. The cluster also protects against bias from the one test you like.
answer.ur: Kyunke zyada tar akele tests ki accuracy mehdood hoti hai. Cluster odds badalta hai: har aik mazeed positive finding imkaan barhati hai ke shak sahi hai, aur negative cluster usay ghatati hai. Cluster us ek pasandida test ke bias se bhi bachata hai.

beats.patient: A 54-year-old woman has left shoulder pain for 8 weeks. It spreads to the forearm, is worse when she looks down at her phone, and her left triceps reflex is reduced. Shoulder movement is full and painless. The distraction test eases the arm pain.
beats.assessment: The shoulder screens clear, while neck posture changes the symptoms, a reflex is reduced and distraction gives relief. This points to a cervical root cause (probably C7) rather than a shoulder problem.
beats.treatment: Treat the neck: explain the source, give postural and cervical mobility and neural-friendly exercise, avoid sustained neck flexion, and check progress with the same tests. Refer if weakness or reflex loss worsens or red flags appear.
beats.reassess: After two weeks the arm pain eases and the distraction test is no longer needed for relief. If a clear improvement does not appear, refer back for imaging and medical review.

text.en: **Do not manipulate the neck or back until red flags are excluded.** Progressive weakness, numbness in both hands or feet, gait change, bladder or bowel change, severe unrelenting pain, fever or a history of cancer need medical assessment first. Chest pain with arm pain is a heart problem until proved otherwise: stop and call for help.
text.ur: **Red flags khatam hone tak gardan ya kamar ki manipulation na karein.** Barhti hui kamzori, dono haathon ya paon mein sunn, chalne ka tareeqa badalna, peshab ya pakhaane ki tabdeeli, shadeed musalsal dard, bukhaar ya cancer ka record ho to pehle medical assessment chahiye. Bazu ke dard ke saath seene ka dard jab tak sabit na ho dil ka masla hai: rukein aur madad bulayein.

text.en: A clinical prediction cluster for cervical radiculopathy (Spurling, distraction, upper limb tension test A and rotation under 60 degrees) improved diagnostic certainty when several tests were positive, and a clinical prediction rule for hip osteoarthritis in unilateral hip pain combined pain on squatting, active hip flexion pain, scour with adduction, active hip extension pain and passive internal rotation under 25 degrees. Both rules came from single-centre studies; they guide, but do not replace, your reasoning.
text.ur: Cervical radiculopathy ke liye clinical prediction cluster (Spurling, distraction, upper limb tension test A aur rotation 60 se kam) jab kai tests positive thay to diagnostic yaqeen behtar hua, aur ek taraf ke hip dard mein hip osteoarthritis ka clinical prediction rule squat par dard, active hip flexion ka dard, adduction ke saath scour, active hip extension ka dard aur passive internal rotation 25 se kam ko jorta tha. Dono rules ek hi center ki studies se aaye thay; yeh rehnumai karte hain, aap ki soch ki jagah nahi lete.

text.en: **Story, Both sides, Change one thing.** Hear the story, test both suspects, then change one thing and re-test. If one test finds the answer, check it with another.
text.ur: **Kahani, Dono taraf, Ek cheez badlein.** Kahani suniye, dono shak walon ko test karein, phir ek cheez badal kar dobara test karein. Agar ek test jawab de de to doosre se confirm karein.

summary.en: Pain can be referred, so test the joint above and below, and never diagnose from one test.
summary.ur: Dard refer ho sakta hai, isliye upar aur neeche ka joint test karein, aur ek test se diagnosis kabhi na karein.

summary.en: Use clusters (neck: Spurling, distraction, upper limb tension, rotation; hip: groin pain, internal rotation loss, scour) and change one thing to confirm.
summary.ur: Clusters istemal karein (gardan: Spurling, distraction, upper limb tension, rotation; hip: groin dard, internal rotation ka kam hona, scour) aur confirm karne ke liye ek cheez badlein.

summary.en: The answer can be both, or neither; explain it clearly and refer when red flags or neurological change appear.
summary.ur: Jawab dono ya koi nahi ho sakta hai; wazahat se samjhayein aur red flags ya neurological tabdeeli par refer karein.

front.en: Which sign can ease neck-related arm pain?
front.ur: Gardan se arm ke dard ko kaun si cheez kam kar sakti hai?

back.en: Placing the hand on top of the head (shoulder abduction relief).
back.ur: Sar par haath rakhna (shoulder abduction relief).

front.en: Name two clues that point to the hip, not the spine.
front.ur: Do clues batayein jo reedh nahi balke hip ki taraf ishara karein.

back.en: Groin pain and limited, painful hip internal rotation.
back.ur: Groin ka dard aur hip ki mehdood aur dardnaak internal rotation.

front.en: Why is one special test never enough?
front.ur: Ek khaas test kabhi kaafi kyun nahi?

back.en: Most tests have limited accuracy; clusters change the odds.
back.ur: Zyada tar tests ki accuracy mehdood hoti hai; clusters odds badalte hain.

front.en: What should you always do for arm pain?
front.ur: Bazu ke dard mein hamesha kya karein?

back.en: Screen the neck as well as the shoulder.
back.ur: Kandhay ke saath gardan bhi screen karein.

note.ur: Clusters akele tests se behtar kyun hain.
